description: Find where injection pressure is consumed along the flow path. Each reading is the CUMULATIVE peak pressure needed to fill through that section — an air shot gives the nozzle figure, then sprue, runner, gate and the full part — so the values ascend. Known sections: Nozzle, Sprue, Runner, Gate, Part. Run every reading at the velocity the viscosity curve selected.

intensificationRatio.description: Hydraulic-to-plastic multiplier; omit if pressure is already plastic

machineMaxPressure.description: Machine maximum injection pressure, same units as pressure

pressure.description: Cumulative peak pressure to fill through this section, psi

stage.description: Section name, e.g. one of: Nozzle, Sprue, Runner, Gate, Part

study_code.description: A study as the Lab card encodes it; use instead of the measurements (stages, machineMaxPressure, intensificationRatio)

name: pressure_drop
title: Pressure-drop study
